items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Miff Mole and Ernie Caceres I had... We just went up there and did a one night gig.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, yeah, 'cause Carmen Jones was well, it was legit theatre, Wednesday matinee and a Saturday matinee and that ended then, yeah.
Also it says here that you had a brief trip to Canada with Miff Mole's band, August 1943.
Uh huh. Well that was while I was rehearsing for Carmen Jones, a little gig that I got together and took Miff Mole up there with me.
